buildCommand: npx prisma generate && npx prisma generate --schema=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && next build
//buildCommand: This OVERRIDES the build script in package.json -- Vercel prefers vercel.json. U8 moved the auth schema to packages/db and this line was missed on the first attempt, so the deploy failed with "Could not load --schema from provided path prisma/auth-schema.prisma". If the schema path changes again, BOTH this file and package.json must change together.
